NATIONAL WATER SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE BOARD ACT, No. 02 OF 1974
Order under Section 92

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No.02 of1974, I, Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, do hereby approve the acquisition of theimmovable property, shown in the following Schedule as it is required by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board,for the construction of Water Storage Tank and Access Road of Hemmathagama Water Supply Project.

RAUFF HAKEEM,Minister of City Planning andWater Supply.Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply,No. 35, ‘Lakdiya Medura’,New Parliament Road,Pelawatta, Battaramulla,10th October, 2017.5/2/1/1287SCHEDULE

An allotment of land called Panapure Division of Ambadeniya Estate in Lot No. 35, 36 and 37 of Plan No. 281and containing in total extent of about 46 perches, situated at the village of Thalgaspitiya Panapure in the Grama NiladhariDivision of Thalagaspitiya Muslim gama Wasama (44 C) in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Aranayaka in KegalleDistrict and bounded as follows :—
North by:Lot 13 of the same Plan (Access Road) ;East by:Lot No. 38 of the same Plan ;South by:Land claimed by villages and Lot 34 of the same Plan ;West by:Land Lot 33, 34 and 13 of the same Plan.
Name and address of the claimant: 01. Mrs. M. H. Aisha Seilaniya,No. 225, Casel Street, Borella,Colombo 08.11- 222

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, by Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No.02 of 1974,I, Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, published an order of the Gazette ExtraordinaryNo. 2033/47 dated 23.08.2017 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, the Schedule to which mentions thelot number as 01 and 02 of the land which, I hereby declare, should be corrected to read us lot number 01 and 03.
